app.name: Source keys
app.summary: A row of keys with logos for a select: PC, Mac, PlayStation, Switch. A tap switches the source.
app.tile_example: PC, Mac, PS5 and Switch as keys
app.script_hint: Optional. A tap runs this script with the option as a field instead of choosing the option itself, so it can wake the monitor and switch the input.
app.field_hint: The script's field that gets the option, such as quelle or source.
app.keys_hint: Optional. One key per line as Option|logo, such as PC|windows. Logos: windows, apple, playstation, nintendo-switch, xbox, linux. Empty: every option of the select, with a logo guessed from its name.
app.labels_hint: The option's name under each logo.
app.picture_hint: Optional, on a tile two rows high. A switch that is on while the monitor shows its picture; its key turns only the picture off and on.
app.power_hint: Optional, on a tile two rows high. A switch that is on while the monitor is on; its key turns the monitor off, or on while it is off.
app.head: Head line
app.head_hint: The monitor's name and state over the keys.
app.row_size_hint: How much of the tile the monitor's keys take; the rest is for the sources.
app.auto_hint: Optional, with the monitor's keys. A switch or input boolean that says whether this source turns the monitor on by itself. While its key is chosen, an Auto key beside the monitor's keys turns it on and off.
